title: Back-rank and basic mates
summary: Spot the trapped king: back-rank mates and finishing with the queen.
body:
A king behind its own unmoved pawns has **no escape squares**. A rook or queen landing on that back rank is mate.

- **Attacking:** when the enemy king is boxed in, check every back-rank check first. If a defender can block, capture the blocker.
- **Defending:** give your king air (h3/h6) once the position calms down, and keep a rook on the back rank.
- **Finishing:** with king and queen against a lonely king, use your king to cover escape squares and give mate on the edge.

examples.prompt: White to move and mate in one.
examples.explain: Ra8# - the pawns on f7, g7 and h7 take away every escape square.

examples.prompt: White to move and mate in two.
examples.explain: Ra8+ forces Rb8 to block, and Rxb8# - the blocker can be captured with mate.

examples.prompt: White to move and mate in one.
examples.explain: Qh8# - your king covers a7 and b7, the queen covers the whole eighth rank.
